method: For each generated campaign layout, classify substantial placements using the s211c world solid flag/baked-box rule, then require a non-physics-only placement collider to cover every active tier 0-6. Collider presence does not prove visual hull quality or movement contacts.
remaining: The L6/L7 Northgate metro exit is a solid interactive building whose gate must swing open for the L6-to-L7 route. Its static shell currently has no placement collider. A safe shell collider must preserve the open gate passage and be validated against the route before these two offenders can be cleared.
